requirements.text: * Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field **OR** 2+years full-time Software Engineering work experience, **WHICH INCLUDES** 1-year total technical software engineering experience in one or more of the following areas:Programming language (e.g. JavaScript or TypeScript)
* Modern web frameworks (e.g. React, VueJS, or Angular), plus HTML, CSS, and web APIs
* Understanding of modern web application architecture, including rendering strategies, state management, and client-server data flow
* Algorithm and data structure fundamentals, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked lists, DFS, and BFS
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Experience with back-end systems (e.g. Go, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js) to work across the stack
* Web performance optimization (e.g. Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering, bundle size)
* Experimentation and analytics (A/B testing, metrics, observability tools such as Grafana)
* Experience with large-scale consumer products such as e-commerce, marketplaces, or discovery/feed experiences
* Using AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude) across the development cycle, including code generation, testing, and documentation
